title: Implement stable skill identity, locator, and digest helpers
objective: Compute deterministic SkillID, canonical locator, SHA-256 content digest, and entry revision inputs independently of Manager.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Canonicalize filesystem and virtual resource locators.
Keep source in the identity so same-name skills remain distinct.
Compute digest from the exact effective SKILL.md content used for invocation.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Implement pure helpers over task_01 value types.
Add cross-platform path, symlink/virtual locator, and digest determinism tests.
Reject ambiguous or empty locators with stable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Same source and canonical locator yield the same ID.
Same name at different sources or locators yields different IDs.
Digest changes exactly when effective content changes.
dispatch_prompt: Implement pure stable identity/locator/digest helpers in new files. Do not modify loader.go or other task-owned files.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
